title: File:Oldest recording of the Quran 1885.oga
description: The oldest known recording of the Adhan. It was recorded in Mecca in 1885 by Christiaan Snouck Hurgronje using the newly invented wax cylinder. The source, CNN, does not say this is the oldest recording of the Adhan, nor does it name a recording date; the year 1885 is very unlikely, since – accordin
